name: qdrant_health_check
description: Check Qdrant service health and connectivity.

name: qdrant_get_version
description: Get the Qdrant service version.

name: qdrant_get_telemetry
description: Get Qdrant telemetry data including request counts and performance metrics.

name: qdrant_get_metrics
description: Get Prometheus-compatible metrics from Qdrant.

name: qdrant_list_collections
description: List all vector collections in the Qdrant instance.

name: qdrant_get_collection
description: Get details for a Qdrant collection including vector config, point count, and index status.

name: qdrant_create_collection
description: Create a new Qdrant vector collection with specified vector size and distance metric.

vector_size.description: Embedding dimension (e.g. 1536 for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 384 for nomic-embed-text)

name: qdrant_create_collection_named_vectors
description: Create a Qdrant collection with multiple named vector spaces (multi-vector support).

vectors_config.description: Object mapping vector names to {size, distance} e.g. {'text': {size: 384, distance: 'Cosine'}}

name: qdrant_delete_collection
description: Delete a Qdrant collection and all its vectors.

name: qdrant_update_collection
description: Update a Qdrant collection's optimizer or HNSW index configuration.

name: qdrant_get_aliases
description: List all aliases across all collections.

name: qdrant_list_collection_aliases
description: List aliases pointing to a specific Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_create_alias
description: Create an alias for a Qdrant collection — enables hot-swap without changing client code.

name: qdrant_delete_alias
description: Delete a Qdrant collection alias.

name: qdrant_rename_alias
description: Rename a Qdrant alias (atomic swap — no downtime).

name: qdrant_create_payload_index
description: Create a payload field index for efficient filtered search (e.g. index 'user_id' as keyword).

field_schema.description: keyword, integer, float, bool, geo, text, datetime

name: qdrant_delete_payload_index
description: Remove a payload field index from a Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_upsert_points
description: Insert or update vectors (points) in a Qdrant collection. Each point needs id, vector, and optional payload.

name: qdrant_get_point
description: Get a single vector point by its ID from a Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_get_points
description: Get multiple vector points by their IDs from a Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_delete_points
description: Delete specific points by ID from a Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_delete_points_by_filter
description: Delete all points in a Qdrant collection matching a filter condition.

name: qdrant_count_points
description: Count the number of points in a Qdrant collection, optionally filtered.

name: qdrant_scroll_points
description: Paginate through points in a Qdrant collection with optional filtering and ordering.

name: qdrant_update_payload
description: Merge additional fields into the payload of existing points (by ID or filter).

name: qdrant_overwrite_payload
description: Replace the payload of points entirely (all existing payload fields are removed).

name: qdrant_delete_payload
description: Remove specific payload keys from points.

name: qdrant_clear_payload
description: Remove all payload from points (vectors are preserved).

name: qdrant_update_vectors
description: Update only the vector values of existing points without changing their payload.

name: qdrant_delete_vectors
description: Delete named vectors from points in a multi-vector collection.

name: qdrant_search
description: Search for semantically similar vectors in a Qdrant collection using an embedding vector.

name: qdrant_search_batch
description: Run multiple vector searches in a single Qdrant API call.

name: qdrant_search_groups
description: Search for similar vectors and group results by a payload field value.

group_by.description: Payload field to group results by

name: qdrant_recommend
description: Find similar points based on example point IDs (positive examples) and optional negative examples.

positive.description: IDs of example points to find more like

name: qdrant_recommend_batch
description: Run multiple recommendation queries in a single Qdrant API call.

name: qdrant_recommend_groups
description: Recommend similar points and group results by a payload field.

name: qdrant_discover
description: Discovery search — find points in an area of the vector space using context pairs (positive+negative examples).

name: qdrant_discover_batch
description: Run multiple discovery searches in a single Qdrant API call.

name: qdrant_list_snapshots
description: List all snapshots (backups) for a Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_create_snapshot
description: Create a snapshot (backup) of a Qdrant collection.

name: qdrant_delete_snapshot
description: Delete a Qdrant collection snapshot.

name: qdrant_list_full_snapshots
description: List all full-instance snapshots (covers all collections).

name: qdrant_create_full_snapshot
description: Create a full instance snapshot of all Qdrant collections.

name: qdrant_get_cluster_info
description: Get Qdrant cluster topology, node status, and shard distribution.

name: qdrant_get_collection_cluster_info
description: Get shard and replica distribution for a specific collection in the Qdrant cluster.

name: qdrant_upsert_documents
description: SUPER TOOL: Upsert a batch of documents into Qdrant — automatically maps document fields to point id, vector, and payload.

documents.description: Array of documents with vector field + any payload fields

id_field.description: Field to use as point ID (default: id)

name: qdrant_setup_collection
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a production-ready collection with best-practice HNSW settings and optional payload field indexes in one call.

index_fields.description: Array of {name, type} objects for payload indexes

name: qdrant_collection_status
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a comprehensive status snapshot for a collection — info, exact point count, and all aliases in one call.
